newsitem.title: USA: Dow rallies to session high, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rallies to session high, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips powered to session highs in the last minutes of Tuesday's session, fueled by a series of late buy programs.
The Dow Industrials rose 55 points to 7044 and the S&P 500 gained six to 814. Birinyi Associates said a buy program was currently underway on the New York Stock Exchange.
The NYSE implemented its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1539 EST/2039 GMT.
